_comment: Tuning knobs for parse.mjs. Everything here is optional — the parser works
off heuristics alone, and you only edit this when it guesses wrong.
areaOverrides: force a Kaplan unit name onto a content area. Keys are matched
case-insensitively against the unit name, substring match. Values must be one
endpoints: once you know which Kaplan endpoints hold your data (capture.mjs
prints the list), name them here and the parser reads only those instead of
scoring every payload. Substring match against the request URL.
ignoreUnits: unit names to drop entirely (e.g. an orientation chapter).
